strategy.summary: Plunge and nudge the ball into the center Pit hole for 1,000,000. Collect T on the return. Shoot the center loop for P and I. Then shoot the lit ramp for another Pit plunge.

steps.text: On the first plunge, learn the power and smallest cabinet movement that guide the ball toward the center Pit hole.
modeNotes: Pit rings: The four concentric rings score 25,000, 50,000, 75,000, and 1,000,000 at the center when lit.

steps.text: Aim each normal Pit plunge at the center 1,000,000 award.
Let the Pit return roll through the T lane.
Shoot the center loop. The shot collects P and I and feeds the left inlane.
modeNotes: P-I-T: Completing the three letters lights the left ramp green for another Pit trip.

steps.text: Shoot the lit left ramp. It returns the ball to the shooter lane and keeps the return gates closed.
Plunge for another center Pit collect. Repeat the T, center-loop, ramp, and plunge cycle.
Do not choose a smaller Pit ring unless a useful Extra Ball or Special is lit there.

fallback.title: 15x three-ball Multiball
fallback.when: Use this plan when the center Pit award is disabled or the plunge is not repeatable.

steps.text: Complete either C-Y-S target bank until the playfield multiplier is useful.
modeNotes: Playfield X: It multiplies all Multiball scoring, not end-of-ball bonus. It carries between balls and reaches 15x.

steps.text: Shoot the spinner lane to reach the upper L-O-K lanes.
Use the right flipper to move the lit lanes. Roll through L, O, and K to lock one ball. Complete three sets.
modeNotes: Three-Ball Multiball: The third L-O-K set starts it. Normal playfield scores use the stored Playfield X. There is no Jackpot or dedicated collect.

steps.text: During Multiball, shoot the lit 5,000-per-spin spinner only while its return is safe.
Use the extra balls to complete Wall, Guard, and C-Y-S targets. Multiball ends when one ball remains.

alternatives.title: Wall and Guard Extra Ball
alternatives.when: Use this plan when Extra Ball is enabled and the standup rebounds are safe.

steps.text: Hit one or two Guard standups while part of the Wall remains raised.
Complete the Wall drop bank.
During the short beeping timer, finish all three Guard standups.
Extra Ball lights at the second Pit ring for one trip. Aim for that ring on the next plunge.

alternatives.title: Lit-spinner Multiball scoring
alternatives.when: Use this plan only with a useful Playfield X and a controlled spinner return.

steps.text: Roll through a lit blue inlane. Shoot the spinner before its short timer ends.
modeNotes: Spinner: Roll through a lit blue inlane to start the timer; spinner hits then score 5,000 per spin until it ends.

steps.text: Start Three-Ball Multiball and repeat the lit spinner for multiplied switch value.
Stop when the spinner return is no longer controlled.
Make the center Pit skill shot.
Collect T on the return. Shoot the center loop for P and I.
Shoot the lit ramp for a replunge.
Repeat the center Pit skill shot.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm whether the shooter-lane switch is connected; if disconnected, complete P-I-T to light the center 1,000,000 award.
Confirm whether Extra Ball and Special are enabled or converted to points before choosing a Wall-and-Guard collect.

strategy.simpleOverview: Arena begins with a plunge toward the center Pit hole for 1,000,000. Let the return collect T, shoot the center loop for P and I, then shoot the lit left ramp to return to the shooter lane. Repeat the Pit, T, center-loop, and ramp cycle.
strategy.overview: Arena uses each center Pit collect to begin a repeatable P-I-T loop. Plunge the center 1,000,000 Pit hole, collect T on the return, shoot the center loop for P and I, then use the lit left ramp to return to the shooter lane with the gates closed. Repeat while the plunge and ramp feeds remain predictable.
machineSetup: Confirm whether the shooter-lane switch is connected; if disconnected, complete P-I-T to light the center 1,000,000 award.
Confirm whether Extra Ball and Special are enabled or converted to points before choosing a Wall-and-Guard collect.
